# Hydrostatic and well-balanced treatment {#sec-ch05}

<!-- PROVENANCE
pin: snapy@e894700ff7aee30b52882e5202b16461413780b0 (chengcli/snapy)
sources: OUTLINE.md chapter 5; docs/derivations/wb-ref4.md, wb-ref-wall.md, x1-centroid-spherical.md at the pin
status: draft
-->

A stratified atmosphere at rest is the state snapy's $x_1$ sweep has to leave alone, and it is the hardest one:
its pressure and density change by orders of magnitude along $x_1$, while the motions of interest are small
perturbations of it. This chapter describes how the $x_1$ reconstruction keeps such a column at rest to round-off
and how close the reference it uses comes to the column's own profile. It covers, in the order the code builds
them: the well-balanced $x_1$ reconstruction, which reconstructs perturbations about a discretely hydrostatic
reference; the reference kernel, which builds that reference from a top-down pressure scan; its closure at a
physical wall; its continuity across $x_1$ block seams; the hydrostatic mode, which replaces gravity by the cell's
own pressure difference; `balance_column`, which projects an initial column onto the scheme's discrete balance;
the fourth-order reference `SNAP_WB_REF4`; the $r^2$-exact $x_1$ maps `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` of spherical-polar
grids; what is left of the $1/R$ term after them; and two legacy wall routines. The gravity work these schemes are
used with is Chapter 6 (@sec-ch06); the switches and their tested combinations are Chapter 12.

All derivations of this chapter are checked by one executable check, `src/snapy_report/ch05/wbref_check.py`,
whose output `wbref_check.out` carries the claim tags `[C1]`–`[C21]`; claim `[C11]` is an independent rebuild of
the default reference from the equations of this chapter that reproduces the numbers snapy's own wall test prints.

<!-- PENDING: the chapter's dependency map (STYLE.md section 10.1) is drawn from the switch coverage matrix of
     Chapter 12 through the house dependency-map function, which is not in this tree yet. -->

| scheme | switch | default | order | main test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| WB $x_1$ reconstruction (@sec-ch05-wbx1) | gravity on | on | rest exact | `test_face_floor` |
| Reference kernel (@sec-ch05-refkernel) | with the WB path | on | 2 ($\rho_{\mathrm{sf}}$) | `test_hydro_ref_x1` |
| Wall clamp and continuation (@sec-ch05-wallclamp) | `wb-wall-clamp` | on | 2 at walls | `test_wb_ref_wall` |
| Seam continuity (@sec-ch05-seam) | $x_1$ split | on | exact | `test_pref_local_seam` |
| Hydrostatic mode (@sec-ch05-hsmode) | `non-hydrostatic` | 1 (off) | rest exact | `test_hydrostatic` |
| `balance_column` (@sec-ch05-balcol) | API call | not called | fixed point | `test_balance_column` |
| Fourth-order reference (@sec-ch05-wbref4) | `SNAP_WB_REF4` | off | 4 ($\rho_{\mathrm{sf}}$) | `test_wb_ref4_order` |
| $r^2$-exact $x_1$ maps (@sec-ch05-x1cent) | `SNAP_X1_CENTROID_EXACT` | off | rest exact | `test_x1_centroid_rest` |
| $1/R$ remainder (@sec-ch05-oneoverr) | none | — | $O(h^2/R)$ | none |
| Legacy wall routines (@sec-ch05-legacy) | none | unreachable | — | none |

: The schemes of this chapter. "Order" is the order of the face density reference $\rho_{\mathrm{sf}}$ against the
exact profile where a number is given; "rest exact" means a discretely balanced column stays at rest to round-off.
Full ctest names and tolerances are in each scheme's Tests layer and in the chapter's catalogue in Chapter 15. {#tbl-ch05-schemes}
